slug.description: Stable filename slug. Optional: the loader derives it from the artifact's filename under `.workspec/<kind-dir>/<slug>.yaml` when absent; when present it must already be a valid slug.

catalog.description: Bare-slug intra-tree ref → decisions/catalogs/*: the decision catalog resource costs in this topology price against.

connections.description: The declared connection graph. May be empty for a topology with no edges yet.

items.description: A declared edge between two resources.

class.description: Edge class: "primary" for request-path connections, "telemetry" for observability edges (e.g. a resource shipping metrics to a monitor). Defaults to "primary".

environments.description: Subset of the topology environments this connection is active in. Omitted means active in all of the topology's environments.

items.description: A WorkSpec slug: lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens, at most 64 characters (the shape `slugify()` produces).

from.description: Bare-slug intra-tree ref → resources/*: the edge source resource.

to.description: Bare-slug intra-tree ref → resources/*: the edge target resource.

defaultEnvironment.description: The environment shown by default; must be one of `environments`.

environments.description: Bare-slug intra-tree refs → environments/*: the environments this topology spans.

items.description: A WorkSpec slug: lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens, at most 64 characters (the shape `slugify()` produces).
